name: hidden-version
description: An audited entity that declares its OWN 'updated_at' and marks it hidden. The schema mapper injects a framework-managed column only when the entity does not declare a field of that name, so this declaration wins — and masking it used to leave the API with no ETag to hand out and the caller with no If-Match to send, switching optimistic concurrency off with no error anywhere. This descriptor exists to be REFUSED at apply; nothing here is meant to work.

records.description: An audited entity whose own 'updated_at' declaration replaces the framework's.
